definitions.explanation: A person whose profession is teaching.

examples.japanese: {教師|きょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教師|きょうし}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{教師|きょうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。

notes:
{教師|きょうし} refers to teachers as a profession.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {教師|きょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (become a teacher)
- {教師|きょうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (work as a teacher)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教師|きょうし} (teacher of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {教師|きょうし}: teacher (profession-focused, neutral)
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: teacher (respectful, also used as address)
- ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧: teaching staff (institutional term)
- ⟦{教諭|きょうゆ}→教諭：30765_kyouyu⟧: licensed teacher (official title)

Note: When addressing a teacher, always use ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧, not {教師|きょうし}.
